response.sql: SELECT COALESCE(s.insurstat, 'Unknown') AS insurance_status, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) AS site_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref)) OVER () AS share FROM scanconservation sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY COALESCE(s.insurstat, 'Unknown')
